'''Maria Kokoszyńska-Lutmanowa''' (born '''Maria Kokoszyńska''', 6 December 1905 – 30 June 1981<ref name=":0" />) was a Polish logician, philosopher of language and epistemologist. She belonged to the third generation of the [[Lwów–Warsaw school]]. She is mostly known as the author of the important argumentation against neopositivism of the [[Vienna Circle]] as well as one of the main critics of relativistic theories of truth.<ref name=":1" /> She was also noted for popularising [[Alfred Tarski|Tarski]]'s works on [[semantics]].

Kokoszyńska studied philosophy in [[Lviv|Lwów]] under [[Kazimierz Ajdukiewicz]] (and [[Kazimierz Twardowski]]) at the [[Jan Kazimierz University]], and at the [[University of Cambridge]] under [[Ludwig Wittgenstein]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite book |last=Tałasiewicz |first=Mieszko |url=https://brill.com/display/book/9789004457799/B9789004457799_s016.xml |title=Maria Kokoszyńska-Lutmanowa – Methodology, Semantics, Truth |date=2001-01-01 |publisher=Brill |isbn=978-90-04-45779-9|doi=10.1163/9789004457799_016}}</ref>

She later held the chair of logic at the [[University of Wrocław]].<ref name=":0">Brożek, Anna. [https://archive.org/details/2927articletext632111020170213 ‘Maria Kokoszyńska: Between the Lvov-Warsaw School and the Vienna Circle.]’ ''Journal for the History of Analytical Philosophy'' 5.2 (2017).</ref><ref name=":1">Kawczyński F. (2018) [https://books.google.com/books?id=ueZfDwAAQBAJ&dq=%22mostly+known+as+the+author+of+the+important+argumentation+against+neopositivism+of+the+Vienna+Circle+as+well+as+one+of+the+main+critics+of+relativistic+theories+of+truth%22&pg=PA235 Maria Kokoszyńska-Lutmanowa: The Great Polemist]. In: Garrido Á., [[Urszula Wybraniec-Skardowska|Wybraniec-Skardowska U.]] (eds) ''The Lvov-Warsaw School. Past and Present''. Studies in Universal Logic. Birkhäuser, Cham {{Doi|10.1007/978-3-319-65430-0_17}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* Kokoszyńska, M., (1936), 'Über den absoluten Wahrheitsbegriff und einige andere semantische Begriffe', ''[[Erkenntnis]]'' 6, 143–156.
* Kokoszyńska, M., (1948), 'What means "relativity of truth"?', ''Studia Philosophica'' 3, 167–176.
* Kokoszyńska, M., (1951), 'A refutation of the relativism of truth', ''Studia Philosophica'' 4, 1–57.
<nowiki>*</nowiki>For a complete listing of Kokoszyńska's publications see Jan Zygmunt's Bibliography.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Zygmunt |first=Jan |date=2004-06-01 |title=Bibliografia prac naukowych Marii Kokoszyńskiej-Lutmanowej |url=https://www.fn.uw.edu.pl/index.php/fn/article/view/403/296 |journal=Filozofia Nauki |language=pl |volume=12 |issue=2 |pages=155–166 |issn=2657-5868}}</ref>
